placement: dedicated management station outside guest OS; actual station/hypervisor NOT_OBTAINED

roles.owner: provisions approved VM-scoped management service and raw retention; identity NOT_OBTAINED
roles.operator: enrolls exact target, checks policy/source/budget and starts no guest before R receipt; identity NOT_OBTAINED
roles.recoveryOwner: maintains independently reachable console and manual runbook; no finite automatic guarantee; identity NOT_OBTAINED

acl: VM-specific read/status and power-stop capability only; deny other VM/global/role-admin/create/rollback operations; actual ACL NOT_OBTAINED
credentials: mutual authenticated endpoint; secret in approved station OS protected credential store/service identity, never manifest/argv/log; fingerprint/issuer/expiry/keyID only; revocation blocks enrollment/new commands; reissue new session/epoch after review, no reuse
antiReplay: cryptographically unique command nonce, exact session+epoch+target generation, monotonic ledger sequence; persist consumed IDs before action; crash/uncertain commit -> UNKNOWN/BLOCKED no automatic replay/retry
enrollment: R receipt durable+readback, target/ACL/clock/budget and operator bound before guest creation; creation requires capability referencing that receipt
detection: R own monotonic receive-clock records heartbeat receipt/missed deadline and hard ceiling; do not trust guest timestamp or M timer. Provider/frequency NOT_BOUND; actual configuration remains unapproved

failures.R_HANG: NONE; other observer/manual may record NOT_OBTAINED; R cannot guarantee own failure output
failures.LINK_DOWN: guest channel loss not proof M/process death; remaining BLOCKED
failures.KERNEL_HANG: external endpoint availability NOT_TESTED, guest raw may be lost
failures.ENDPOINT_FAILURE: accepted/stop status UNKNOWN, no retry or deadline extension
failures.ACL_DENIED: record denial; do not elevate rights
failures.LEDGER_FAILURE: durability NOT_OBTAINED; block guest/new actions, safety action cannot wait unbounded on storage

laneProofs: fresh independent source for each; VM stop not guest handle exit; request acceptance not stop; persist requires external bytes/size/SHA+independent reread
milestones: AK candidate only NOT_APPROVED, not runtime settings
